name: Iswadi Pratama
bio: Iswadi Pratama (born April 8, 1971) is an Indonesian writer, director, playwright, and actor.

credits.title: The Sea Speaks His Name
credits.overview: Set during the volatile final months of Indonesia's New Order regime, the narrative chronicles a young student activist's perilous commitment to pro-democracy underground movements and his family's subsequent, grueling quest for justice following his forced disappearance.

credits.title: Four Seasons in Java
credits.overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. credits.title: 24 Hours with Gaspar
credits.overview: With only 24 hours left to live, a private investigator follows a trail of confounding clues to uncover the disappearance of his childhood friend.
